newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila bourse closed Dec 31, other markets unsure.
newsitem.headline: Manila bourse closed Dec 31, other markets unsure.

text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) will be closed on December 31, New Year's Eve, a bourse official said.
The PSE market development office said December 27, Friday, will be the last trading day of the year. Trading will resume on January 2.
December 30 is a public holiday as Filipinos commemorate the death anniversary of national hero Jose Rizal. New Year's Day, January 1, is also a national holiday.

There was still no official announcement regarding the domestic interbank and foreign exchange markets. Central Bank governor Gabriel Singson said he would check with the presidential palace regarding any holiday proclamation.
However, Bankers Association of the Philippines official Jaime Panganiban told Reuters that Thursday's spot dollar/peso deals will be settled on January 2, instead of December 31.
"December 31 is normally a bank holiday," he said.
